mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `rooms`( town_id, host_id, market_name, meet_place, meet_at )VALUES( #{townId}, #{hostId}, #{marketName}, #{meetPlace}, #{meetAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, town_id, host_id, market_name, meet_place, meet_at, max_participants FROM `rooms` WHERE id = #{roomId}

SELECT r.id, r.market_name, r.meet_place, r.meet_at, r.max_participants, COUNT(rp.id) AS currentParticipants FROM rooms r LEFT JOIN room_participants rp ON r.id = rp.room_id WHERE r.town_id = #{townId} GROUP BY r.id
mapper.update: UPDATE `rooms` SET current_participants = current_participants + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{room_id} AND current_participants < max_participants
mapper.select: SELECT id, max_participants FROM `rooms` WHERE id = #{roomId} FOR UPDATE
